frozen: 2026-11-27, after set D (diagnosis) and before set E; written by the lab, pending user confirmation
scope: chat-templated long documents (>= 4096 tokens), teacher-forced; dense positions FIRST..n-2, the prefill path at every STEP-th length plus the prompt length

pairs.0: N0 dense: llama ub1 vs ub512
pairs.1: self serve: Astral step vs serve
pairs.2: cross step: llama ub1 vs Astral step
pairs.3: cross serve: llama ub1 vs Astral serve
pairs.5: N0 prefill: llama ub1 vs batch
pairs.6: self prefill: Astral step vs prefill
pairs.7: cross prefill: llama ub1 vs Astral prefill

hard: every case has all 8 pairs with the expected position counts
why: Set D (T20) is a high-sensitivity regime: llama.cpp's own ub1 vs ub512 flips the argmax at 1-2% of positions whose ub1 margin is >= 2 to 8 nats and has KL mean 0.10-0.33, so an absolute argmax gate or absolute KL limits cannot separate engine defects from the regime. Every limit is a ratio to llama.cpp's own shape control on the same positions, pooled over all positions of the set, plus a per-document bound.
